description: A3-48 no-ToUnicode corpus. TWO Type 3 fonts sharing the same six glyph procedures and the same Widths array. The first uses Adobe Expert small-caps glyph names, recoverable to SECRET by src/core/ToUnicodeRecovery.cpp; the second uses opaque producer-invented names carrying no Unicode information, which stay unsearchable and are the residual half of the A3-48 false-negative class. Regenerated by gen_f18_backlog_corpus.py for GitHub #23.
